nodes.name: Local QA design state
nodes.description: Optional DESIGN_STATE_DIR: SQLite on a persistent local Docker volume, shared only within the single-process start_all runtime. Stores candidates, atomic revisions, paid-attempt usage and publication intent/receipts. No network database or HA service.

single-owner-recovery.description: Exclusive lifecycle flock, FULL synchronous transactions, generation fencing, bounded paid attempts, and audited offline recovery. Photon requests register child attempts before sending; verified preflight CPU rejections release reservations, preserve bounded retry waits and resume generations, while unknown outcomes stop replay. Streams closed before a stop reason are charged at input plus the output ceiling, never cached, and resent at most once per confirmed generation. Confirmed unsent cancellations release reservations. Stale backups require operator reconciliation.

reviewed-patch-upgrade.description: Offline patch upgrade verifies the previous build manifest against the stored fingerprint, requires the exact reviewed source-change list and unchanged config source, model policy, provider and targets. Atomically audits the new fingerprint and resume request without resetting usage, deadline, budget, candidates or remote receipts; unresolved outcomes remain blocked.

nodes.name: QA recovery operator
nodes.description: Local authorized operator stops the application owner before inspection, evidence-backed publication resolution, resume requests or a new completed-parent execution. No HTTP recovery write endpoint.
